name: Re-Editor
description: A small extension source editor. Used by the AI authoring loop to open, inspect and rewrite plugin files without leaving FanCAD.

commands.title: Edit Extension File
commands.description: Opens one file from an extension in the built-in editor. The AI authoring loop uses this after writing a plugin so a person can review the generated source.

params.name: path
params.description: Relative path inside the extension folder

commands.title: List Extension Files
commands.description: Lists the files of an extension that the editor can open.
